attempts.summary: Deployed an Ansible playbook from node2 (the only node with Ansible installed, used as control node) that installs /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app on node1 with daily rotation, 7 compressed rotations, and copytruncate so the application keeps writing to the same file after rotation. Verified functionally (forced rotations, write continuity, retention pruning to exactly 7 .gz files) and confirmed persistence and idempotency across a full restart of both managed nodes.
